CROSS-REFERENCE.

SUBJECT: K. Groehl.

On 1.6.39 Karl Groehl wrote to Otten and Paris
said he was leaving London on Sunday for London. He also wrote:

"Im D. ist die ganze S.Z.P. hochgegangen".

Information sent to S.I.S. on 5.6.39.
